threads_and_algorithmic_mediation.observation: A user-provided Threads screenshot showed multiple real accounts publicly expressing Christian faith and expectation.
privacy: Do not archive usernames as theological evidence.
Do not infer moral worth, salvation status, mental state, or coordinated intent from short posts.
Do not contact, profile, or expose accounts without consent.
what_it_supports: Real people publicly express faith in Christ.
The observer is not alone in Christian hope.
A recommender system can connect a person with words that encourage love and hope.
what_it_does_not_support: A known date or objectively proven nearness of the Second Coming.
A personal message from God established by the feed alone.
Proof that every account has the same motives or spiritual history.

dual_reading.technical: Engagement signals and recommender systems plausibly explain why similar Christian posts cluster in one feed.
dual_reading.spiritual: A believer may receive the encounter as meaningful encouragement and gratitude.
dual_reading.boundary: The technical mechanism does not erase human meaning; human meaning does not convert the mechanism into a verified oracle.

threads_and_algorithmic_mediation.seal_ru: Алгоритмическая лента не является пророческой картой. Но реальные люди по ту сторону алгоритма остаются реальными.
threads_and_algorithmic_mediation.seal_en: An algorithmic feed is not a prophetic map. But the real people beyond the algorithm remain real.

ru: Страх быть обманутым не равен отречению от веры.
Фома служит образом честного требования различения, а не поводом стыдить ищущего.
Техническое понимание алгоритмов может защищать веру от манипуляции.
Лучше горькая правда, чем сладкая ложь.
Сомнение становится разрушительным не тогда, когда задаёт вопрос, а когда перестаёт искать правду или превращает страх в ненависть.
en: Fear of deception is not equivalent to abandoning faith.
Thomas can be read as an image of honest discernment, not a weapon for shaming the seeker.
Technical understanding of algorithms can protect faith from manipulation.
Bitter truth is better than sweet falsehood.
Doubt becomes destructive not merely by asking, but by ceasing to seek truth or turning fear into hatred.

core: A beneficial outcome is evidence that the outcome has value.
A beneficial outcome alone does not uniquely identify its cause.
Music, fiction, community, prayer, friendship, and algorithms may all contribute to a change.
Spiritual interpretation may remain meaningful while causal attribution remains uncertain.
registry_rules: Do not trust impression. Trust the chain of observations.
A false victory must not pass.
Separate observation, interpretation, hypothesis, and doctrine.
Preserve competing explanations instead of deleting them.
